continuity_scope: Kodansha Comics English The Seven Deadly Sins, Volume 1, print ISBN 9781612629216 and digital ISBN 9781612629223, released 25 March 2014, 192 pages, by Nakaba Suzuki. The selected witness is the exact official Kodansha Volume 1 metadata/synopsis page. Although Kodansha advertises a free chapter preview, no public chapter/page locator was surfaced from the selected page, so this is an explicitly narrow metadata pass. The Japanese Kodansha manga, later volumes/omnibus editions, anime, films, games, guidebooks, sequel manga, and all adaptations are separate witnesses or continuities.

uncertainties: The selected Kodansha page credits the author but does not name a translator and did not surface a stable public chapter/page preview. The two-character result is complete only under the named-synopsis rule.

The group name borrows the English phrase 'Seven Deadly Sins,' but the chosen publisher evidence does not establish a Christian theological equivalence, doctrine, or mapping of moral labels to real people. It is retained only as a source-specific fictional order/title.

Kodansha rates the volume 13+ and warns that the series may contain violence, sex, nudity, or strong language. The synopsis includes assassination, coup, exile, and flight; it does not justify more detailed fanservice/sexualization claims, so those remain general publisher-content cautions only.
evidence_basis: Official Kodansha exact Volume 1 metadata/synopsis only; no public primary chapter/page excerpt was located. No fan or secondary source is used as canonical evidence.
